title: Sparsely connected rank-inspired neural network
summary: We propose a Sparsely Connected Rank-Inspired Neural Network (SCRINN) for function approximation and the numerical solution of partial differential equations (PDEs). By introducing a structured sparse connectivity architecture and an orthogonality- and normalization-guided loss function, SCRINN constructs an approximately orthonormal neural basis while promoting progressive rank growth of its evaluation matrix and reducing the number of trainable parameters.
